label: caiso perhub-shaping diag (PROBE)
definition: (PROBE) Keeper config + --caiso-per-hub-intertie + --interchange-shaping. Tests the grounded import-volume lever (measured EIA-930 availability envelope). Fixes import HOURS (95.9% vs 85.9% actual) and diurnal shape, but OVERCORRECTS volume: net imports under-shoot every year (21.2/24.7/31.7 vs actual 28.9/32.4/36.2 TWh) and gas over-burns vs EIA-923. Not a keeper; the correct fix is per-hub SIGNED legs (see HANDOFF-caiso-import-volume-and-2023-data-2026-06-24). 2023 uses the static-ladder fallback for hub LMP (OASIS data aged out), shaped only by the EIA-930 envelope.
